scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
application_mode: Online Citizen Portal / National Rooftop Solar Portal
prerequisites: Electricity Consumer Account Number with latest paid electricity bill
Ownership of residential roof with shadow-free area (min 10 sq.m / 100 sq.ft per kW)
Aadhaar card of the electricity consumer
Active savings bank account with cancelled cheque for DBT subsidy release

application_steps.portal_action: Navigate to pmsuryaghar.gov.in -> 'Apply for Rooftop Solar' -> Select State & DISCOM

input_fields.name: state
input_fields.description: State where consumer connection is located

input_fields.name: electricity_distribution_company
input_fields.description: Local DISCOM (e.g. BSES, Tata Power, UPPCL, TANGEDCO)

application_steps.verification: SMS OTP sent to mobile number. Profile created with DISCOM consumer validation.

application_steps.portal_action: Submit online rooftop solar application. DISCOM approves transformer load feasibility within 15 days.
application_steps.verification: DISCOM technical feasibility review. Applicant signs agreement with registered vendor.

application_steps.portal_action: Vendor installs solar modules and grid-tie inverter. Apply for bidirectional net meter.

input_fields.name: almm_module_serial_numbers
input_fields.description: Approved ALMM Solar PV Module serial numbers

input_fields.name: installation_completion_certificate
input_fields.description: Joint inspection certificate signed by vendor & consumer

application_steps.verification: DISCOM junior engineer conducts physical inspection and commissions bidirectional net meter.

application_steps.portal_action: Upload bank details and cancelled cheque. National Portal releases DBT subsidy directly to bank.
application_steps.output_artifact: DBT Subsidy Reference Number generated; ₹30,000–₹78,000 credited within 30 days of commissioning.
